lines.en: My footfalls make the floorboards groan.
A step, a pause; I do not care to hurry.

lines.zh: 这身布面下面全是金属。
lines.en: Under this cloth is nothing but metal.

lines.zh: 走廊太窄，我的肩擦着墙。
lines.en: The hall is narrow; my shoulders scrape the wall.
I round the corner, and my shadow arrives first.
I know my way around this building.

lines.zh: 每一步都像有人在敲鼓。
lines.en: Every step lands like a drumbeat.

lines.zh: 我不躲藏，走得光明正大。
lines.en: I do not hide; I walk in the open.
Wiring hums beneath the floor.
My top hat stays crooked.
I've pulled back the stage curtain.
The doorframe is too low for me.

lines.zh: 我站在走廊里，慢慢张望。
lines.en: I stand in the hall, looking slowly about.

lines.zh: 帽檐下的眼睛没有焦点。
lines.en: The eyes under my brim have no focus.
I am not looking for anyone.
The light overhead keeps buzzing.
My teeth do not close.
There are old patches on the cloth.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的铃。
lines.en: I wait for a bell that will not ring.
Everything here is newer than I am.
Someone walked past, and I paid no mind.
My fingers splay wide open.
I stay until six.
I am not tired, and do not know tiredness.
The wallpaper on this floor is peeling.
I count the hallway lights going out.
Paper scraps underfoot; I avoid them.
Standing long or short makes no difference.
You stand at the far end of the hall.
I see you and do not move.
Your flashlight shakes badly.
I do not like the light.
You have taken two steps this way.
I tilt my head.
You know what I look like.
You also know I should not move.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在走廊里有回音。
lines.en: Your breath echoes in this hall.
I hear it.
One step more and I will remember you.
My smile is painted on.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的影子压住了。
lines.en: Your shadow is caught under mine.
You have not decided whether to run.
I wait for your decision.
There are only the two of us on this floor.

lines.zh: 你的影子很长，我的更长。
lines.en: Your shadow is long; mine is longer.
You have pressed your back to the wall.
I tilt, then straighten again.
The cloth splits and shows metal.
I did not step back.
Something rattles inside.
You mean to take me apart.
My teeth grind once.
I record that hit in my gears.
I do not cry out, and I do not beg.
I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 你这一下，打歪了我的下巴。
lines.en: That hit knocked my jaw crooked.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴不是用来吃的。
lines.en: This mouth of mine is not for eating.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我的嘴张不开。
lines.en: That little thing, my jaw won't open for it.
I cannot even bite.
Leave it; it will rot.
My jaw is fixed in place.
Pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 这味道我的舌头尝不出。
lines.en: My tongue cannot taste that.
You are the only one here who gets hungry.
I do not eat any of this.
Do not let it block my way.
You bumped my chest and bounced away.
Not one step back.
This is simply how I am built.

lines.zh: 我的牙比玩偶该有的多。
lines.en: I have more teeth than a toy should.
I felt nothing.
Do not come at me from behind.
This hall is not wide enough for two.
Step aside; I go first.
My shoulder hit the doorframe.
You are caught between the wall and me.
This body is meant to be looked at.
There is no one inside.

lines.zh: 你对着我说这些做什么？
lines.en: Why say that to me?
There are only gears in my joints.
I should not be treated this way.
Step back a little.
I cannot do these things.
Let us talk of something else.
That laugh of yours does not fit.
I will not answer that.
I see something fall to the floor.
This back will not bend.
My fingers are too thick.
It lies at the edge of my shadow.
You pick it up.
This should not be here.
I wait for someone to take it.
My foot nearly came down on it.
I pay the floor no mind.
The one who sweeps will come.
You struck at me.

lines.zh: 我的头一格一格转过去。
lines.en: My head turns one click at a time.
I remember the blow you landed.
Now I know where you are.
I will not keep looking about.
My fingers have closed.
The hall has no other exit.

lines.zh: 噩梦的熊，不敲门就进来。
lines.en: A nightmare bear doesn't knock.
Then let it start here.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，你看着不舒服吧。
lines.en: My head is tilted; it bothers you, does it not.

lines.zh: 这一下我没打算给你时间。
lines.en: I do not mean to give you time.

lines.zh: 你的手那点力气，我知道。
lines.en: I know how little force is in your hands.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯全灭了也不要紧。
lines.en: It does not matter if every light goes out.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛本来就不靠它。
lines.en: My eyes never needed them.
How long can you keep standing?
One step and I'm before you.
I shift toward where you are.
I no longer look elsewhere.
Your flashlight holds on me.
I do not slow.
Retreat, and I walk on anyway.
The floor here is short.
Running to the next floor will not help.
I hear your steps.
Your breath grows shallower.
I press toward you step by step.
You glanced back at the door.
That door is on my side.
Your steps are starting to stumble.
I have no need to run.
There are no windows on this floor.
You will tire first.
I do not even have to breathe.
I rather like this stretch of hallway.
I bring my palm down.
My fingers dig into your shoulder.
That was not light.
My palm does not shove you away.
You are still there.
I have raised my hand again.

lines.zh: 我的身板撞上你的胸口。
lines.en: My mass hits your chest.
You are forced to bend.
This one will last you a year.
I draw my hand back slowly.
This claw is my greeting.

lines.zh: 我的手掌比你整个头还大。
lines.en: My palm is larger than your whole head.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，还在我手边。
lines.en: One step back and you are still within reach.
One more and it is over.
Do you hear my joints grinding?
My hand does not rise quickly.
The light at the end of the hall goes out.
I stand inside the doorway.
It is colder here than I remember.

lines.zh: 有人动了不该动的东西。
lines.en: Someone touched what should not be touched.
The eyes under the hat are lit.
I take one step out.
The floor sinks a little.
This floor has only you and me.

lines.zh: 我闻到了空气里的铁味。
lines.en: I smell iron in the air.
Tonight will be long.
The smile is still on my face.
That smile was not made for you.
The air in this hall is dry.

lines.zh: 噩梦的牙，从光里探出来。
lines.en: Nightmare teeth slide out of the light.
My shadow is dragged out very long.
Someone has locked the doors.
Good; I did not want to leave either.

lines.zh: 你听见地板的响声了吗？
lines.en: You hear the floor creak, do you not?

lines.zh: 布面烧起来，火里有金属味。
lines.en: The cloth catches fire, and the flames smell of metal.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上滚下去，一路在响。
lines.en: I tumble down the stairs, ringing all the way.

lines.zh: 水从布面渗进去，我变得很沉。
lines.en: Water soaks through the cloth and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推到墙上，布面撕开。
lines.en: The blast throws me to the wall and tears the cloth.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的肩，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks fast in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道光让我全身的齿轮一滞。
lines.en: That light makes every gear stall.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是越来越旧。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only grow older.

lines.zh: 雷从我帽顶灌进去，一路烧到底。
lines.en: Lightning pours in at my hat and burns all the way down.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地板，我直着落下去。
lines.en: There is no floor and I fall straight down.
